newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 22.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories on Tuesday.

WASHINGTON - AT&T Corp said its net income from continuing operations fell 24 percent in the first quarter, largely because of competition in its core long-distance business and costly investments it is making to enter emerging markets.

WASHINGTON - A senior Clinton administration official condemned congressional efforts to cut estate taxes as part of this year's federal budget agreement, declaring proponents of such tax relief to be motivated by "selfishness."
WASHINGTON - Washington National and Dulles International airports generated $5.5 billion worth of business revenues in 1995.
WASHINGTON - WMX Technologies is an example of the high-growth company that falters when it exhausts its market or doesn't keep up with a changing environment.
